name: A column flex item that is a wrapping row gets its wrapped height, so later items stay inside the container

events.message: six 300px items with 20px gaps wrap to two lines in 964px: 50 + 20 + 50 + 36 padding = 156
at 664px content width two items fit per line: three lines, 3x50 + 2x20 + 36 = 226
